title: Function card
responsibility: Shows one function as a compact card with its contract, consumers, verification mark and links to its overview and recorded tests.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.row
inputs.description: The function at the viewed revision: its name, purpose, contract, consumers and verification result.

inputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard.nav
inputs.description: The selected branch and commit, with navigation that keeps both when opening the function or its tests.

outputs.name: ExplorerFunctionCard
outputs.description: A readable function card with declared inputs and output, no design image, an icon to open it and a link to its recorded input-to-output tests.
